description.value:
Energetic nodes connect to the mech's weapon mounts.

Selection: When installed, choose two energy types from: acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic.

@PPAbility[cost:2]{Energize Weapon} Convert half of a weapon's damage to one of the chosen energy types for 1 turn.

@PPAbility[cost:2]{Boomerang Strike} Grant the returning fusion to a thrown melee weapon for 1 minute.
